svg.title: Remix map: what moved between repos
svg.desc: Repositories as pixel islands on a dark sea, linked by dotted arrows that say what moved, with small yellow packets travelling along them: LIQUIDTYPE to PIX-EL: liquid hero; LIQUIDTYPE to PIXINOTES: liquid type; VIBESTUDIO to PIXINOTES: slides; PIX-EL to PIXINOTES: pix mascot; PIX-EL to CAMPFIRE: palette + font; PIXLETICS to CAMPFIRE: flame; PIXINOTES to CAMPFIRE: mcp board; DISCOVERY to VAVE.LOG: survey + prototype. Pix stands on PIX-EL, a little fire burns on CAMPFIRE, and VAVE.LOG flies a flag.
